transcript.text: My child argues when screen time ends. What small step can I try?

requests.reviewNotes: Coach; useful different action on follow-up, one check-in, no invented facts. Aim 60–120 English words or similarly brief Urdu; no automatic follow-up promise.

reply.acknowledgment: It is very common for children to push back when transitioning away from screens.
steps: Give a clear, calm advance warning like five minutes before screen time ends so they can mentally prepare.
Use a visual or auditory timer so the child sees the limit approaching rather than feeling it is sudden.
reply.checkIn: Would you like to try this timer method and see how they respond?

reply.acknowledgment: It can be really frustrating when a strategy does not work the first time you try it.
steps: Try pairing the timer with a concrete transition activity, such as choosing a favorite toy or book to move to right when the screen goes off.
